definitions.explanation: Materials used for teaching and learning, including textbooks, workbooks, handouts, digital content, and other instructional resources.

notes:
USAGE:
Covers a broad range of materials from traditional textbooks to digital learning content. In modern usage, ⟦デジタル→デジタル：05870_dejitaru⟧{教材|きょうざい} (digital teaching materials) and ⟦オンライン→オンライン：05278_onrain⟧{教材|きょうざい} (online materials) are increasingly common.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {教材|きょうざい}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{作|つく}る→作る：00481_tsukuru⟧: to create teaching materials
- {教材|きょうざい}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{活用|かつよう}する→活用する：21424_katsuyousuru⟧: to make use of teaching materials
- {教材|きょうざい}⟦{開発|かいはつ}→開発：06746_kaihatsu⟧: teaching material development
- ⟦デジタル→デジタル：05870_dejitaru⟧{教材|きょうざい}: digital teaching materials

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{教科書|きょうかしょ}→教科書：01085_kyoukasho⟧: textbook (a specific type of teaching material)
- ⟦{参考書|さんこうしょ}→参考書：05142_sankousho⟧: reference book, study guide
